Welcome. I’m glad you’re here with me, because we’re about to step into a world that feels just a little more vivid, a little more intense, and sometimes—let’s be honest—a little overwhelming.
Have you ever felt like your emotions run just a bit deeper, or that the smallest things—like a passing comment or a bright light—seem to leave a lasting impression? If so, you’re in good company. Together, we’ll explore the experience of being highly sensitive, and how it can color every moment, sometimes in beautiful ways, and sometimes in ways that leave us feeling worn out.
Drawing from the wisdom of Elaine N. Aron’s book, The Highly Sensitive Person: How to Thrive When the World Overwhelms You, we’ll navigate the science behind sensitivity, peek into the ups and downs of relationships, and discover why self-care isn’t just a luxury—it’s a necessity.
Living as a highly sensitive person means learning to honor what makes us different, while also finding ways to thrive in a world that rarely slows down. We’ll talk about how to turn sensitivity into a source of strength, and how to transform those vulnerable moments into resilience.
So, whether you’re exploring your own sensitivity, or hoping to better understand someone you care about, let’s take this journey together. There’s so much to discover—and I promise, you’ll walk away with new insights and a deeper appreciation for the beauty of being sensitive.
